structures.name: 客户体验碎片化问题
structures.subject: 营销与销售分离导致客户体验碎片化

elements.name: 客户不分割体验
elements.description: 客户不区分营销和销售，将所有触点视为单一关系的一部分

evidence.quote: Customers do not distinguish between the two.

elements.name: 组织图表驱动设计
elements.description: 公司围绕组织图表而非客户现实设计流程

evidence.quote: The organizations that design around that reality, rather than around their own organizational charts

elements.name: 分离数据集
elements.description: 营销和销售运营在分离的数据集和系统上

evidence.quote: When marketing and sales operate on separate data sets and disconnected systems

elements.name: 碎片化成本
elements.description: 跨团队信息不一致是客户更换供应商的首要原因

evidence.quote: buyers cite inconsistent information across teams as the top reason for switching suppliers

When marketing and sales operate on separate data sets... buyers cite inconsistent information across teams as the top reason for switching suppliers

constraints.statement: 客户体验是单一连续体

evidence.quote: Every touchpoint...is experienced as a part of a single relationship.

structures.name: AI驱动的整合转型
structures.subject: Agentic AI如何推动营销与销售的整合

elements.name: 收入增长集中
elements.description: AI带来的最一致收入增长集中在营销和销售领域

evidence.quote: the most consistent revenue gains from AI are concentrated in marketing and sales

elements.name: 执行收敛
elements.description: 执行日益跨越曾经不同的营销和销售活动

evidence.quote: execution increasingly spanning what were once distinct marketing and sales activities

elements.name: 持续循环
elements.description: 活动从顺序执行转变为持续循环

evidence.quote: Activities that once moved sequentially across teams increasingly operate in continuous loops

elements.name: 共享责任
elements.description: 营销和销售共同负责管道质量、转化和客户价值

evidence.quote: Marketing and sales increasingly share responsibility for pipeline quality, conversion, and customer value
the most consistent revenue gains from AI are concentrated in marketing and sales... execution increasingly spanning
execution increasingly spanning... Activities that once moved sequentially across teams increasingly operate in continuous loops
Activities that once moved sequentially... Marketing and sales increasingly share responsibility

constraints.statement: 优势只有在两个函数贡献并使用相同数据系统时才会复合

evidence.quote: The advantage compounds only when both functions contribute to and draw from the same data system.

structures.name: 闭环运营模型
structures.subject: 领先组织如何设计闭环营销-销售系统

elements.name: 单一系统设计
elements.description: 领先组织将营销和销售重新设计为单一系统

evidence.quote: the organizations pulling ahead are redesigning marketing and sales as a single system

elements.name: 工作本身重新思考
elements.description: 不是在现有流程上叠加AI，而是重新思考工作本身

evidence.quote: Rather than layering AI onto existing processes, they rethink the work itself

elements.name: 技术转变
elements.description: 共享客户数据基础和协调系统

evidence.quote: a shared customer data foundation and coordinated systems

elements.name: 组织转变
elements.description: 共享激励和衡量整个客户旅程的指标

evidence.quote: shared incentives and metrics that measure outcomes across the full customer journey
redesigning marketing and sales as a single system... they rethink the work itself

they rethink the work itself... shared incentives and metrics

constraints.statement: 成功需要技术和组织双重转变

evidence.quote: Success requires two shifts.

Marketing and sales increasingly share responsibility... the organizations pulling ahead are redesigning marketing and sales as a single system

evidence.quote: Buying journeys no longer follow a linear path.

evidence.quote: Humans and AI agents work together in a closed loop
